amend.upstream.description: resolve the open findings while the requirements check is not valid: a finding that changes no scope takes its default decision (an agent, recorded as an assumption with its reason), a scope-changing one waits for a person's decision; the decision amends the questions and the requirements list (new revisions)

dissection.check.description: check the dissection; only while no check is recorded about the current dissection revision

idea.check.description: check idea.yaml against its schema; only while no check is recorded about the current idea revision (each check of this protocol runs once per revision of what it reads: a second record with another result would leave its claim unknown for good)

idea.dissect.description: an LLM splits the idea into typed items, each citing its span; moves the dissection to a new revision; not once the current dissection is valid

questions.answer.description: an agent accepts the default of every question that changes no scope, or changes it; it leaves every scope-changing question open; moves the questions to a new revision; not once the interview is settled

questions.check.description: check the interview's shape and whether it is settled; only while one of the two is not recorded about the current interview revision (the settled check also against the current dissection revision). The one program records both at once; after a revised dissection it records the shape again for an unchanged interview revision, with the same result

questions.write.description: an LLM writes one question per open item, with options and a default answer; moves the questions to a new revision; not once the current interview is valid

requirements.check.description: check the requirements list; only while no check is recorded about the current requirements revision, against the current interview revision

requirements.normalise.description: normalise the facts, wishes and answers into the requirements list; moves the requirements to a new revision; not once the current requirements list is valid

scope.answer.description: answer the scope-changing questions: the principal holding scope.answer (a person, or a decider at the autonomy levels that grant it) accepts each default or changes it, and its answers are recorded with that principal; moves the questions to a new revision; not once the interview is settled. Admissible on an interview whose shape is not checked yet (r6): the person's own edit of an answer moves the questions to a revision no check has seen, and scope.answer is what takes that edit; questions.check runs on the revision it writes. Not on an interview found invalid.

dissection.description: dissection.yaml, the idea's typed items: fact, wish, belief, unknown, ambiguity, dark spot

findings.description: findings.yaml: the typed findings (ambiguity, contradiction, missing decision) any stage raised, each citing the items it conflicts with, with its status and its resolution

idea.description: idea.yaml, an sdc.intake.Idea instance; its revision is the file's sha256

questions.description: questions.yaml, the interview: one question per open item, each with a default answer and its answer, accepted or changed

requirements.description: requirements.yaml, the structural, product-level list of what should be built, each entry citing a fact, a wish or an answer

dissection.checked.description: a check is recorded about the current dissection revision, whatever its result

dissection.valid.description: the current dissection is valid, made from the current idea revision

idea.checked.description: a check is recorded about the current idea revision, whatever its result

idea.shaped.description: the current idea record is a valid sdc.intake.Idea

interview.checked.description: a settled check is recorded about the current interview revision, against the current dissection revision, whatever its result

questions.checked.description: a shape check is recorded about the current interview revision, whatever its result

questions.settled.description: every open item of the current dissection has a settled question

questions.shaped.description: the current interview is valid, every question with a default answer

requirements.checked.description: a check is recorded about the current requirements revision, against the current interview revision, whatever its result

requirements.valid.description: the current requirements list is valid, normalised from the current interview

dissection_shape.description: the dissection check: schema-valid, every item one of the six types, every span a substring of the idea text; its result is valid or invalid

idea_shape.description: `ess generate schema validate` over idea.yaml; its result is valid or invalid

questions_settled.description: the interview check: every open item (belief, unknown, ambiguity, dark spot) has exactly one question, every question is answered accepted or changed, every scope-changing one through scope.answer (its answered_by names the principal that took that action, never the agent's non-interactive); its result is settled, open or needs_scope_answer

questions_shape.description: `ess generate schema validate` over questions.yaml, every question with a default answer; its result is valid or invalid

requirements_shape.description: the requirements check: schema-valid, every requirement cites a fact, a wish or an answer; no open finding; its result is valid, invalid or finding

dissection.revised.description: an interview check observed against an earlier dissection no longer applies

questions.revised.description: a requirements check observed against an earlier interview no longer applies

dissection.required.description: the idea is dissected into typed items

interview.required.description: every open item is asked and settled

passed.description: the idea is dissected, the interview settled and the requirements list valid

protocol.description: Turn an idea into a requirements list (docs/phases.md steps 1 to 3). The idea record is checked against its schema; the idea is dissected into typed items (fact, wish, belief, unknown, ambiguity, dark spot), each citing its span of the idea; every open item becomes an interview question with a default answer, accepted as is or changed, every scope-changing one through the action scope.answer, which needs the capability scope.answer (the runtime grants it per autonomy level: a person at A0 to A2, a decider at A3 and up); the answers are normalised into a requirements list. Every result is a program's exit status, never an LLM's word. A revised dissection invalidates the interview check, a revised interview the requirements check. A revised idea opens a new intake case (the root's intake.open is bound to the idea revision), so this case declares no invalidation from the idea. The case ends passed; abandoning the idea is the root case's decision. Late findings (docs/trial-2.md, "The late-finding loop"): the requirements check also reads the open findings and is not valid while one is open; amend.upstream resolves them by amending the questions and the requirements list.
